description: This file defines a Java interface named MessageMapperRegistry, which manages a collection of message mappers, including retrieving default mappers, obtaining mappers for specific payloads, and validating payload mappings.

classes.name: MessageMapperRegistry
classes.description: An interface managing message mappers, providing methods to get default mappers, retrieve mappers for specific payloads, and validate payload mappings.

methods.name: getDefaultMapper
methods.description: Returns a fallback message mapper used as a default strategy.

methods.name: getMappers
methods.description: Provides a list of message mappers suitable for a given payload mapping.

methods.name: validatePayloadMapping
methods.description: Validates whether a provided payload mapping can be resolved within the registry.
